items.title: Drew Lock: Returning to No. 2 role
items.body_text: Lock will return to a backup role for Sunday's game at Washington after coach Mike Macdonald said Friday that Sam Darnold (glute) is "going to play," John Boyle of the Seahawks' official site reports. Visit RotoWire.com for more analysis on this update.

items.title: Dallas Goedert: No practice again Friday
items.body_text: Goedert (knee) didn't practice Friday. Visit RotoWire.com for more analysis on this update.

items.title: DeVonta Smith: Limited at Friday's practice
items.body_text: Smith (hamstring) practiced in a limited capacity Friday. Visit RotoWire.com for more analysis on this update.

items.title: Saquon Barkley: Full practice Friday
items.body_text: Barkley (stinger) was a full practice participant Friday. Visit RotoWire.com for more analysis on this update.

items.title: Saquon Barkley: Will wear protective gear Monday
items.body_text: Barkley (stinger) said Friday that he's "feeling good" this week and will wear protective gear around his neck during Monday's contest at Chicago, Dave Zangaro of NBC Sports Philadelphia reports. Visit RotoWire.com for more analysis on this update.
